# Psicopedagogia por Amor — Project Context for LLMs & AI Agents

> Management Platform for Psychopedagogy Clinical Practice & Commercial Landing Page for Dra. Raiane E. Ferreira.

## Core Documentation Files
- [README.md](./README.md): Project overview, features, quick start guide, and folder structure.
- [ARCHITECTURE.md](./ARCHITECTURE.md): System architecture, Mermaid diagrams, Firestore NoSQL data schemas, and security rules.
- [AGENTS.md](./AGENTS.md): Instructions, coding rules, route mapping, and verification protocols for AI models and coding agents.

## Core Tech Stack
- Frontend: React 18, TypeScript, Vite, TailwindCSS v4, Lucide React
- Backend: Firebase Authentication, Firestore NoSQL, Firebase Storage
- Integrations: Google Calendar API (OAuth 2.0), jsPDF + html2canvas (PDF generation)

## Key Entities & Roles
- Roles: `admin` (Psychopedagogist Dra. Raiane) and `patient` (Parent/Client)
- Firestore Collections: `profiles`, `appointments`, `documents`, `anamnesis`, `patient_evolutions`, `invoices`
